npcs.name: Gym Hand Ivy
dialogue: Only rangers who get past ME earn a shot at the Warden.

outro: Wilted... The Warden is waiting at the back.
postDialogue: The Warden's Thornback is slow but it hits like a falling tree.

npcs.name: Warden Thorne
dialogue: So you're the ranger Elm let through.
I am Thorne, warden of the Bramble Gym. My grove does not bend to visitors.
Show me roots or be pulled out!

outro: You've earned the Bramble Badge, ranger — the first proof of your climb.
Take TM03 as well. Vine Lash, from my own bramble.
postDialogue: Badge holders are always welcome in Bramblehollow. Grow strong.
